name: Romani Archaman
relations: Ritsuka Fujimaru, Mash Kyrielight, Leonardo da Vinci

skills.name: Tactical Command
skills.effect: Provides real-time Rayshift monitoring and combat analysis from Chaldea.

skills.name: Medical Diagnostics
skills.effect: Monitors Master vital signs and Servant spiritual core stability.

skills.name: Tenth Ring's Wisdom
skills.effect: Hidden authority linked to the ancient King of Magic.

lore: Head of the Medical Department at Chaldea Security Organization who assumed leadership as Acting Director after the Lev Lainur incident.
Despite his laid-back demeanor and love for virtual idols, he tirelessly supports Ritsuka and Mash through every Singularity.

voiceLines.title: Command Room
voiceLines.text: Good work out there! Take a breather, grab some strawberry shortcake, and let's review the data.

name: Kirei Kotomine

skills.name: Bajiquan Mastery
skills.effect: Devastating close-quarters martial arts capable of shattering spiritual defenses.

skills.name: Black Keys
skills.effect: Throws conceptual blades consecrated by the Holy Church to pin shadows.

skills.name: Baptism Rite
skills.effect: Spiritual purification capable of exorcising corrupted souls.

lore: A priest dispatched by the Holy Church to serve as the impartial Overseer of the Holy Grail War.
Behind his stoic clerical vestments lies a man constantly seeking the meaning of his own distorted nature.

voiceLines.title: Overseer Greeting
voiceLines.text: Rejoice, young Master. Your wish shall surely be granted at the end of this conflict.

name: Zhongli

skills.name: Dominus Lapidis
skills.effect: Summons a Stone Stele and generates an impenetrable Jade Shield.

skills.name: Planet Befall
skills.effect: Brings down a falling meteor that deals massive Geo damage and Petrifies foes.

skills.name: Arcanum of Crystal
skills.effect: Refunds portion of ore and preserves ancient historical contracts.

lore: A mysterious consultant invited by the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor, possessing boundless knowledge of Liyue's history and traditions.
In truth, he is Morax, the Geo Archon who stepped down from his divine throne after fulfilling a final contract.
